description: Explore repository commit history and diffs. Actions: list (browse commits with filters), get (retrieve commit metadata and stats), diff (view code changes). Related: browse_refs for branch/tag info.

action.description: Action to perform: list, get, diff

all.description: Include commits from all branches. Required for 'list' action(s).

author.description: Filter by author name or email. Required for 'list' action(s).

first_parent.description: Follow only first parent (linear history). Required for 'list' action(s).

order.description: Commit ordering: default or topo. Required for 'list' action(s).

path.description: Filter commits affecting this file/directory path. Required for 'list' action(s).

per_page.description: Number of items per page (default: 20, max: 100) Required for 'list', 'diff' action(s).

ref_name.description: Branch/tag name. Defaults to default branch. Required for 'list' action(s).

sha.description: Commit SHA. Can be full SHA, short hash, or ref name. Required for 'get', 'diff' action(s).

since.description: Start date filter (ISO 8601 format). Required for 'list' action(s).

stats.description: Include file change statistics. Required for 'get' action(s).

trailers.description: Include Git trailers (Signed-off-by, etc.). Required for 'list' action(s).

unidiff.description: Return unified diff format. Required for 'diff' action(s).

until.description: End date filter (ISO 8601 format). Required for 'list' action(s).

with_stats.description: Include stats for each commit. Required for 'list' action(s).

name: browse_commits
